# MetaEntitiesSelect

<!-- description:start -->
A suggest-based select component for choosing Tracker meta entities (projects, portfolios, goals, or reports) inside a plugin. Renders each entity with its icon and display name, supports async item fetching, loading states, error display, and a clear button.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {MetaEntitiesSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {MetaEntitiesSelectProps} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {MetaEntityV2} from '@weavix/tracker-api-types';

<MetaEntitiesSelect
    getItems={(text) => fetchProjects(text)}
    onChange={(entity) => console.log('selected', entity)}
/>;
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Async or sync function called to fetch items.
     * Receives the current text input and should return a list of MetaEntityV2 objects.
     * Called on mount (getItemsOnMount) and on every text change.
     */
    getItems?: (text: string) => MetaEntityV2[] | Promise<MetaEntityV2[]>;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the user selects an entity from the suggest list.
     */
    onChange?: (entity: MetaEntityV2) => void;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the text input value changes.
     */
    onTextChange?: (text: string) => void;

    /**
     * Current text value of the input (controlled).
     */
    text?: string;

    /**
     * Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.
     * @default 'Select a project'
     */
    placeholder?: string;

    /**
     * Error message or boolean to display an error state on the control.
     */
    error?: string | boolean;

    /**
     * Whether to show a clear (×) button when a value is selected.
     * @default true
     */
    hasClear?: boolean;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to each item in the suggest list.
     */
    itemClassName?: string;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

## Types

```ts
// From @weavix/tracker-api-types
type MetaEntityV2 = {
    id: string;
    shortId: number;
    entityType: 'project' | 'portfolio' | 'report' | 'goal';
    self: string;
    version: number;
    createdBy: {self: string; id: string; display: string};
    createdAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    fields?: {
        summary?: {value: string};
        [key: string]: unknown;
    };
};
```

---

## Tracker API

`MetaEntitiesSelect` is data-agnostic — it accepts items via the `getItems` prop. You are responsible for fetching data from the Tracker API and passing it to the component.

Requires the `"tracker:entities:write"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:entities:write"]
    }
}
```

### Getting projects

Use the entities search endpoint to fetch projects (or other entity types):

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/entities/{entityType}/_search']({
    pathParams: {
        entityType: 'project',
    },
    queryParams: {
        fields: ['summary'],
        page:1,
        perPage: 50,
    },
    bodyParams: {
        filter: {},
        filterTypes: ['ALL'],
        input,
    },
});
return result.data; // MetaEntityV2[]
```

> **Other entity types:** The `entityType` path parameter accepts `'portfolio' | 'project' | 'report' | 'goal'`. Use the appropriate value depending on which entities you want to display in the select.

> **Result:** Always return `result.data` from the API response.

---

### Example — Projects select with Tracker API

Fetches projects on every text change using the entities search endpoint. Request errors are caught and passed to the component via the `error` prop.

```tsx
import React, {useState} from 'react';
import {MetaEntitiesSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {MetaEntityV2} from '@weavix/tracker-api-types';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi; // your Tracker API client
    onChange: (entity: MetaEntityV2) => void;
}

export const ProjectSelect: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi, onChange}) => {
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

    const getItems = async (input: string): Promise<MetaEntityV2[]> => {
        setError(undefined);
        try {
            const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/entities/{entityType}/_search']({
                pathParams: {
                    entityType: 'project',
                },
                queryParams: {
                    fields: ['summary'],
                    page:1,
                    perPage: 50,
                },
                bodyParams: {
                    filter: {},
                    filterTypes: ['ALL'],
                    input,
                },
            });
            return result.data;
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load projects');
            return [];
        }
    };

    return (
        <MetaEntitiesSelect
            getItems={getItems}
            onChange={onChange}
            error={error}
            placeholder="Select a project"
        />
    );
};
```
